submarket: HIDDEN MARKET — "How do I function normally again after a C-section while caring for a newborn?"

finding.headline: "Baby on Back vs. My Scar (posture conflict)"
finding.problem: "Everyone expects me to carry my baby on my back like every African mother. But my scar pulls and my back is on fire. I feel I'm failing my culture."
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — "How do I function normally again after a C-section while caring for a newborn?"
finding.person: A 30-yr-old Ugandan mom; culture says tie baby on back in wrapper, but the forward pull + scar guard gives crippling upper-back pain.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone (CS-safe baby-wearing/posture) — unique cultural angle.". Verdict: PASSES (5/5).
